title: VoiceInboxModelOutput
description: Structured-output contract for the OpenAI Responses API enrichment call (see 'Model configuration decision' in local-voice-inbox-mvp-implementation-plan.md). This exact document is intended to be passed as the `text.format` json_schema when calling the Responses API, so it is written to satisfy OpenAI Structured Outputs strict-mode constraints: the root and every nested object sets additionalProperties:false, and every key in `properties` is listed in `required` (optional-ness is expressed via a nullable type union, e.g. `project`). Keywords not supported by OpenAI strict mode (minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum, format, etc.) are deliberately not used anywhere in this file.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the captured idea/note, generated by the model.

summary.description: Concise summary of the transcript and first-pass note.

actions.description: Discrete action items the model extracted from the note. Empty array if none.

project.description: Project or area of life this note appears to belong to, or null if the model could not infer one.

unknowns.description: Open questions or ambiguities the model flagged rather than guessing at. Empty array if none.

urgency.description: Model's assessment of how time-sensitive this note is.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence in the extraction above.
